text: Brent closed at 92.94 USD/bbl on 17 November, essentially flat on the previous close of 92.90 USD/bbl, and is up 3.1% over the week but down 22.1% over the month, with a one-month range of 90.16 to 128.30 USD/bbl. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December on 1 November. Earlier, on 28 September, Genel Energy agreed to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn.
